name: rustup
label: rustup
description: Rust toolchains from rust-toolchain.toml or rust-toolchain.

tools.name: rust
list: echo stable; echo beta; echo nightly; rustup toolchain list </dev/null 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^no installed' | awk '{print $1}' | grep -vE '^(stable|beta|nightly)'; true
installed: rustup toolchain list </dev/null | grep -v '^no installed' | awk '{print $1}' | sed -E 's/-(x86_64|aarch64|i686|arm)[A-Za-z0-9_-]*$//' | sort -u

requires.name: rustup
check: if command -v rustup >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; echo "rustup not found (install it: https://rustup.rs)" >&2; exit 1
